'''Brainee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] associate of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:PapanoidaIonNabbed_SoI.png|thumb|left|200px|Brainee and Greedo get the drop on the Papanoidas]]
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]], [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] and his son [[Ion Papanoida/Legends|Ion]] came to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] looking for [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], whom they suspected of kidnapping the chairman's daughters, [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway]] and [[Che Amanwe Papanoida/Legends|Che Amanwe]]. Brainee and a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] were playing a game of [[Chance cube/Legends|chance cubes]] with Greedo, when they were informed by [[Trella Bare'Ah/Legends|Trella Bare'Ah]], Greedo's [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] girlfriend, about Papanoida's inquiries.

Following Greedo, Brainee and the Weequay attempted to capture Papanoida and Ion, but the Baron turned the tables on them and in turn captured Greedo, holding him at [[Vibroblade/Legends|Vibroblade]]-point. Papanoida brought the group before [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and presented evidence which forced Greedo to confess to his part in the kidnapping.

==Behind the scenes==
During production of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], another Siniteen—later identified as [[Pons Limbic/Legends|Pons Limbic]]—was referred to as "'''Brainee'''".<ref name="Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref>

Brainee was voiced by [[David Acord]] in ''The Clone Wars''.
